name: Ui-chan no Niizuma Diary~
original_name: 憂（うい）ちゃんの新妻だいあり～
source:
When they started to date, Yosuke and Yuu promised to get married when they ended school. Those days pass in the blink of an eye, and they finally get married.
A young's couple love life, suddenly interrupted when Yuu's cousin barges in. 
Still, Yosuke and Yuu live a peaceful married life...

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/Floralia_%E3%80%9C%E3%83%95%E3%83%AD%E3%83%BC%E3%83%A9%E3%83%AA%E3%82%A2%E3%80%9C]Japanese Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
开始交往时，洋介和忧约定，等学业结束便结婚。时光转瞬即逝，他们终于步入婚姻殿堂。
这对年轻夫妻的甜蜜生活，却因忧的表亲突然闯入而被打断。
尽管如此，洋介和忧仍过着平静的婚后生活……

[翻译自[url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/Floralia_%E3%80%9C%E3%83%95%E3%83%AD%E3%83%BC%E3%83%A9%E3%83%AA%E3%82%A2%E3%80%9C]日语维基百科[/url]]
